primary_metric: Share of assigned applicants who open an account
guardrail_metric: Share of opened accounts flagged by fraud monitoring within 30 days
decision_rule: Ship guided if P(guided better) >= 95% and expected uplift >= 1 percentage point and P(guardrail worse by more than 0.5 pp) < 10%, and only if there is no sample-ratio mismatch (chi-square p >= 0.001)
